title: The CREATOR Project: Towards a Computational Electric Machine Laboratory
summary: The Collaborative Research Centre TRR 361/F90 CREATOR (2022-2030) aims at establishing a new paradigm for the simulation-driven design of electric machines. Increasing demands on efficiency, power density and sustainability require the integration of multiphysical effects, advanced materials and complex geometries into the design process. Traditional sequential workflows are no longer sufficient to address these challenges.
